# The map of packages/scenarios

One line per file, in what the file says of itself. The kinds of folder are in [README.md](../README.md).

## `src/`

- [`cast.ts`](../src/cast.ts): Each journey's own people and company (roadmap step 4.11, "a cast per journey").
- [`client.ts`](../src/client.ts): What a journey is handed: a typed client of Capxul, one function per blueprint operation, which calls a world's Core through its door.
- [`coverage.ts`](../src/coverage.ts): Where each claim of claims.md is checked now that scenarios are journeys (docs/roadmap.md, 14 November 2026): in the checks of an operation (src/checks/), which run on every call of it in every journey, and in the steps of the journeys that call it the way the claim says.
- [`domain.ts`](../src/domain.ts): The format of one domain's scenarios: one file of domains/ for each domain of the blueprint (packages/blueprint, src/domains.ts), holding the checks of each of its operations, the journeys it leads and where each claim of its operations is checked.
- [`domains.ts`](../src/domains.ts): Every domain's scenarios, each a file of domains/ (domain.ts): its operations' checks, its journeys and its claims' places.
- [`door.ts`](../src/door.ts): The package's door: the journeys, how one is declared, the client it is handed and the runner's ear.
- [`expectation.ts`](../src/expectation.ts): How a journey says what it expects: `expect`, the failure it fails with, and `given`, the facts of the starting world it was handed.
- [`journal.ts`](../src/journal.ts): What a journey keeps while it runs, and what it tells the runner.
- [`journey.ts`](../src/journey.ts): How a journey is declared.
- [`registry.ts`](../src/registry.ts): Every journey the runner runs, in order: each domain's (domains.ts), domain by domain, each with every operation's checks.
- [`said.ts`](../src/said.ts): A failure in words, for a run record: a typed failure with its tag and every field it carries; anything else in Effect's words, without stack frames.
- [`tries.ts`](../src/tries.ts): How a step calls its operation.

## `src/checks/`

- [`all.ts`](../src/checks/all.ts): Every operation's checks, by name: one set each, written once (one file of this folder), gathered from each domain's scenarios (../domains.ts).
- [`approval-sign.ts`](../src/checks/approval-sign.ts): The checks of every approval.sign (claims.md, approval.sign 1 to 5, org.create 3, org.member.grant 1, and board's org.director.add 1 and org.threshold.set 1): a signature short of the threshold is kept and records only approval_signed; the last one needed sends one transaction, which is in the chain and did not revert, and records approval_signed then approval_landed; a payment and a change to the Board are sent from the signer's own Safe as one UserOperation, and a change to the Board is never kept short of a threshold; a replay answers the same transaction and records nothing; a signature that does not recover the signer, an unknown approval, another person's, and an expired one are each refused and nothing is sent.
- [`board-change.ts`](../src/checks/board-change.ts): What the checks of org.director.add and org.threshold.set share (claims.md of board): a change to the Board is the founder's alone, with one approval, the caller's own, and changes nothing on the chain until it lands; the record gains one board_change_proposed carrying only change, org and action.
- [`common.ts`](../src/checks/common.ts): What the checks of the world's operations share: the world a call acts on, read before the call, and that a refused call or a read leaves the record as it was.
- [`doc-create.ts`](../src/checks/doc-create.ts): The checks of every doc.create (claims.md, doc.create 1 to 3): a document is created as a draft of the doctype asked, with the fields asked, and the record gains its doc_created; a caller with no user on the site and a document the site refuses are refused, naming why, and nothing is made.
- [`doc-submit.ts`](../src/checks/doc-submit.ts): The checks of every doc.submit (claims.md, doc.submit 1 to 4, doc.create 4): an ordinary document posts, and the General Ledger shows its lines, which balance; a payment from the company Safe is held, not posted, for its signer (the caller, at their own signer address), carrying the hash doc.create gave the document; a document that is not a draft, and a payment of more than the Safe holds, are refused, and nothing is held or recorded.
- [`format.ts`](../src/checks/format.ts): The format of an operation's checks.
- [`invite-accept.ts`](../src/checks/invite-accept.ts): The checks of every invitation.accept (claims.md of people, invitation.accept 1 to 3): the caller's pending invitation is accepted and the caller is a member at once, as a member, under the email they sign in with; the record gains one invitation_accepted and the chain is not written.
- [`invite-answer.ts`](../src/checks/invite-answer.ts): What the checks of invitation.accept and invitation.decline share: what they read before the call (the caller's own invitations, and the chain's latest block), and the checks of their three refusals, which leave everything as it was.
- [`invite-decline.ts`](../src/checks/invite-decline.ts): The checks of every invitation.decline (claims.md of people, invitation.decline 1 and 2): the caller's pending invitation is declined and they do not join; the record gains one invitation_declined, carrying neither who declined nor the email, and the chain is not written.
- [`invite-list.ts`](../src/checks/invite-list.ts): The checks of every invitation.list (claims.md of people, invitation.list 1): every invitation it answers was sent to the caller's own email, each once, oldest first, and reading them records nothing.
- [`org-budget-create.ts`](../src/checks/org-budget-create.ts): The checks of every org.budget.create (claims.md of budgets, org.budget.create 1 and 3 to 6): a creation is a Directors' proposal of the budget asked, in its parent's asset and period and within what its parent has left on the chain, with one approval per Director at their own signer address; the record gains one budget_proposed carrying neither the holder, the name nor the amount, then its proposal_opened; nothing reaches the chain.
- [`org-budget-list.ts`](../src/checks/org-budget-list.ts): The checks of every org.budget.list (claims.md of budgets, org.budget.list 1 and 2): the company asked, every budget the chain made for its Safe and no other, in the order the chain made them, its top budget first, each as the chain holds it now; a person who asks belongs to the company; reading it records nothing.
- [`org-budget-show.ts`](../src/checks/org-budget-show.ts): The checks of every org.budget.show (claims.md of budgets, org.budget.show 1 and 2): the budget asked of the company asked, as the chain holds it now, with the people whose Safe wears its hat; a person who asks belongs to the company; reading it records nothing.
- [`org-create.ts`](../src/checks/org-create.ts): The checks of every org.create (claims.md, org.create 1 to 7): a founding answers the company as asked (its board with the founder first, its profile trimmed) and one approval per founding Director before anyone signs; its Safe is Companies House's company Safe for this founder; the same intent resumes it and records nothing; and every refusal names what was wrong and makes nothing.
- [`org-director-add.ts`](../src/checks/org-director-add.ts): The checks of every org.director.add (claims.md of board, org.director.add 1 to 6): it proposes seating the person asked, one more Director at the threshold the Board has, with one approval, the caller's own, and records one board_change_proposed; nothing changes on the chain until it lands.
- [`org-director-list.ts`](../src/checks/org-director-list.ts): The checks of every org.director.list (claims.md of board, org.director.list 1 and 2): the company asked, each Director once with the personal Safe of their cast entry, the founder first; their Safes are the company Safe's owners and the threshold its threshold, on the chain, and each Safe wears the Director hat it names; reading it records nothing.
- [`org-member-grant.ts`](../src/checks/org-member-grant.ts): The checks of every org.member.grant (claims.md, org.member.grant 1 to 7): a grant is a Directors' proposal of the permission asked, with one approval per Director at their own signer address, and the record gains one officer_change_proposed carrying neither the member nor the note, then its proposal_opened; a caller who is not a Director, a person who is not a member, a member with no Safe, a permission held, and a second change while one waits are each refused, and nothing is proposed.
- [`org-member-invite.ts`](../src/checks/org-member-invite.ts): The checks of every invitation.send (claims.md of people, invitation.send 1 to 4): an invitation is pending at once, of the email and role asked, from the caller, the company's founder, to the company asked; nothing is signed, so the record gains one member_invited carrying neither the email nor whose it is, and the chain is not written; its invitee, when a person of the world, lists it.
- [`org-member-list.ts`](../src/checks/org-member-list.ts): The checks of every member.list (claims.md of people, member.list 1 and 2): the company asked, each person once under the email of their cast entry, its Directors before its members, the caller among them when the caller is a person; reading it records nothing.
- [`org-threshold-set.ts`](../src/checks/org-threshold-set.ts): The checks of every org.threshold.set (claims.md of board, org.threshold.set 1 to 5): it proposes the threshold asked for the Directors the Board has, with one approval, the caller's own, and records one board_change_proposed; nothing changes on the chain until it lands.
- [`record-export.ts`](../src/checks/record-export.ts): The checks of every record.export (claims.md, record.export 1 to 4): the record is the world's events, each entry once, in order, carrying exactly its event's fields; a range answers only the positions asked; a world made from a snapshot holds its parent's entries up to it, then its own birth; the events of every call made in making the starting world, and of the journey's own calls, are in it, in order; only the world's owner may read it.
- [`report-run.ts`](../src/checks/report-run.ts): The checks of every report.run (claims.md, report.run 2 and 3, record.export 2): a report answers the report asked and makes nothing; a caller with no user on the site, and a report the site will not open, are refused, naming why.
- [`world-clock-warp.ts`](../src/checks/world-clock-warp.ts): The checks of every world.clock.warp (claims.md, world.clock.warp 1 and 2): a warp moves the world's clock from where it was to where it was asked, every ready site follows, the chain's head is at or after the new time, and the record gains its one clock_warped; a warp backwards, or by anyone but the owner, is refused and the clock stays.
- [`world-create.ts`](../src/checks/world-create.ts): The checks of every world.create (claims.md, world.create 1 to 6): a new world runs with its clock and a record that begins with its birth, the caller owns it and it expires when asked, it is born with its cast, and a refusal says why and makes nothing.
- [`world-list.ts`](../src/checks/world-list.ts): The checks of every world.list (claims.md, world.list 1 and 2): it answers the caller as owner and the platform's limit, and lists by name, each once and no more than the limit, worlds the caller owns, each as world.show shows it and with as many snapshots as world.snapshot.list lists.
- [`world-show.ts`](../src/checks/world-show.ts): The checks of every world.show (claims.md, world.show 1 to 3): it answers the world asked as its own record tells it (its head, and its parent as its lineage), each company with its site's state, and a name with no world is refused naming it.
- [`world-snapshot-delete.ts`](../src/checks/world-snapshot-delete.ts): The checks of every world.snapshot.delete (claims.md, world.snapshot.delete 1 to 3): a delete answers the snapshot as it was listed, of a snapshot no live world hangs from; the record gains one snapshot_deleted, world.snapshot.list lists the others as before and world.show reads as before but for its record head.
- [`world-snapshot-list.ts`](../src/checks/world-snapshot-list.ts): The checks of every world.snapshot.list (claims.md, world.snapshot.list 1 to 3): it answers the world asked and its snapshots, each named once and in the order they were saved, each in use only by live worlds that hang from it, and it records nothing; a caller who is not the owner and a world that does not exist are refused.
- [`world-snapshot-restore.ts`](../src/checks/world-snapshot-restore.ts): The checks of every world.snapshot.restore (claims.md, world.snapshot.restore 1 to 5, world.show 1, record.export 1): a restore makes a separate world, owned by the caller, at a door of its own, holding the source's cast, companies and record up to the snapshot, then its own world_created naming its parent, and leaves the source untouched; a restore that cannot be made is refused and makes nothing.
- [`world-snapshot-save.ts`](../src/checks/world-snapshot-save.ts): The checks of every world.snapshot.save (claims.md, world.snapshot.save 1 to 3): a snapshot holds the world's record position, clock and companies and leaves the world untouched but for its one snapshot_saved; a name already saved, a caller who is not the owner and a world that does not exist are refused, and the record gains nothing.

## `src/domains/`

- [`approvals.ts`](../src/domains/approvals.ts): The scenarios of the blueprint's domain "approvals" (giving a signature an operation asked for): the checks of each of its operations, the journeys it leads (none yet), and where each claim of its operations is checked (../domain.ts).
- [`board.ts`](../src/domains/board.ts): The scenarios of the blueprint's domain "board" (a company's Board, its Directors and how many must sign): the checks of each of its operations, the journeys it leads, and where each claim of its operations is checked (../domain.ts).
- [`budgets.ts`](../src/domains/budgets.ts): The scenarios of the blueprint's domain "budgets" (a company's budgets on the world's chain, and proposing a new one): the checks of each of its operations, the journeys it leads, and where each claim of its operations is checked (../domain.ts).
- [`documents.ts`](../src/domains/documents.ts): The scenarios of the blueprint's domain "documents" (a company's documents on its site): the checks of each of its operations, the journeys it leads, and where each claim of its operations is checked (../domain.ts).
- [`organizations.ts`](../src/domains/organizations.ts): The scenarios of the blueprint's domain "organizations" (founding a company and granting its members permissions): the checks of each of its operations, the journeys it leads, and where each claim of its operations is checked (../domain.ts).
- [`people.ts`](../src/domains/people.ts): The scenarios of the blueprint's domain "people" (who belongs to a company, and the invitations that bring a person in): the checks of each of its operations, the journeys it leads, and where each claim of its operations is checked (../domain.ts).
- [`record.ts`](../src/domains/record.ts): The scenarios of the blueprint's domain "record" (reading a world's record): the checks of each of its operations, the journeys it leads (none yet), and where each claim of its operations is checked (../domain.ts).
- [`reports.ts`](../src/domains/reports.ts): The scenarios of the blueprint's domain "reports" (running a company's reports on its site): the checks of each of its operations, the journeys it leads (none yet), and where each claim of its operations is checked (../domain.ts).
- [`world.ts`](../src/domains/world.ts): The scenarios of the blueprint's domain "world" (making, showing, listing, saving, restoring and deleting whole worlds' snapshots, and moving a world's clock): the checks of each of its operations, the journeys it leads, and where each claim of its operations is checked (../domain.ts).

## `src/journeys/`

- [`books.ts`](../src/journeys/books.ts): What the journeys read of a company's books and chain to observe what a step did: the company Safe's ledger lines and closing balance, what is outstanding on an invoice, a world's state as one value to compare before and after.
- [`branch-the-books.ts`](../src/journeys/branch-the-books.ts): Journey: branch the books of a held payment.
- [`budget-sam.ts`](../src/journeys/budget-sam.ts): Journey: give sam a budget at Northwind.
- [`found-northwind.ts`](../src/journeys/found-northwind.ts): Journey 2: found Northwind and give sam the books.
- [`invite-olga.ts`](../src/journeys/invite-olga.ts): Journey: invite olga to Northwind.
- [`no-going-back.ts`](../src/journeys/no-going-back.ts): Journey: no going back on an accepted invitation.
- [`pay-brightside.ts`](../src/journeys/pay-brightside.ts): Journey: pay Brightside.
- [`seat-sam.ts`](../src/journeys/seat-sam.ts): Journey: seat sam on Northwind's Board.
- [`signatures.ts`](../src/journeys/signatures.ts): How the journeys sign: each signer signs an approval's digest with their own key (support/signing.ts), and a Directors' proposal is signed by dana, whose signature is kept, then by eli, whose signature sends it.
- [`two-operators.ts`](../src/journeys/two-operators.ts): Journey 1: two operators and their worlds.
- [`world-inventory.ts`](../src/journeys/world-inventory.ts): Journey: an operator's inventory.

## `src/support/`

- [`board.ts`](../src/support/board.ts): Reading a company's Board: looks the board operations' checks and the journey "seat sam on Northwind's Board" share.
- [`budgets.ts`](../src/support/budgets.ts): Reading a company's budgets on the world's chain through its door (packages/blueprint, src/common/chain/reads.ts): looks that the budgets operations' checks and the journey "give sam a budget at Northwind" share.
- [`chain.ts`](../src/support/chain.ts): Reading a world's chain through its door (packages/blueprint, src/common/chain/reads.ts): balances of the world's USDC, the hats a transaction minted, and the payments the Payments contract sent.
- [`expect.ts`](../src/support/expect.ts): How a scenario reads an answer: the refusal a call must fail with, the kind of success it must answer, and comparisons whose failures say what was seen.
- [`founding.ts`](../src/support/founding.ts): Founding Northwind as the starting world `founded` describes it, with the journey's own cast: dana founds it with eli as a Director, threshold 2, members sam and pat, and 1,000 USDC of her capital.
- [`hats.ts`](../src/support/hats.ts): The officer hat a grant's execution minted: read from the transaction its last signature sent, through the door a look at that world goes.
- [`inventory.ts`](../src/support/inventory.ts): Reading what an operator has on the platform: their worlds and a world's snapshots, as looks.
- [`names.ts`](../src/support/names.ts): The names the blueprint declares, as a journey writes them: `named["doc.create"]`, `named["InsufficientBalance"]`, `named["Held"]`.
- [`people.ts`](../src/support/people.ts): Reading who belongs to a company and the invitations sent: looks that the people operations' checks and the journey "invite olga to Northwind" share.
- [`record.ts`](../src/support/record.ts): Reading a world's record against the blueprint: every entry names a declared event and carries exactly that event's fields, and the entries a call must have left are what its declaration computes from its payload and answer.
- [`signing.ts`](../src/support/signing.ts): How a person of the cast signs: with their own key, never in a browser (packages/blueprint, src/things/approval/values.ts and src/common/values.ts).
- [`site.ts`](../src/support/site.ts): Reading a company's site through report.run, in the blueprint's vocabulary (`Site`): its General Ledger, Trial Balance and Accounts Payable, and the company Safe's ledger account.
- [`steady.ts`](../src/support/steady.ts): Chain reads that ride out a dropped connection.
- [`tags.ts`](../src/support/tags.ts): A declared refusal's or outcome's tag, taken from its class, so a journey names it by import and never writes it as a string (capxul/declared-names).
- [`wait.ts`](../src/support/wait.ts): Waiting for background work: a site becoming ready, a sent payment posting, a site user appearing.
- [`world.ts`](../src/support/world.ts): Reading a world through the operations: its view, its record, its cast and its companies.
